prompt: One integrated SIM card icon. Its large central chip is the complete company logo, preserving the entire botanical crest, geometric lines and yume.zone ribbon. Gold contact channels frame the logo without crossing it; radio curves integrate with the chamfered card rim. Deep teal enamel, champagne gold and warm ivory rounded-square tile. No separate badges or cropped logo elements. Transparent outside the opaque tile.
packaging: Standard ICNS sizes generated by sips and iconutil; macOS manages Dock icon appearance. No runtime icon override.
